title: Singaporean Children Exempted from Attending National Schools
what_it_is: Singaporean Children Exempted from Attending National Schools

sections.label: Placement of children in schools
sections.summary: About 85% were placed in non-mainstream schools, under 15% were homeschooled, and the rest were exempted for disability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Of these, around 85% were placed in non-mainstream schools based on their educational and well being needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Less than 15% were homeschooled, and the rest were exempted on the grounds of physical, intellectual or developmental disability.
